candidates.excerpt: INDIA bloc parties in Jammu have announced a joint "Save Democracy" rally on October 7, along with district-level protest marches from October 4 to 8. The opposition parties are demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, alleging irregularities in the electoral process and raising concerns over voter deletions and "vote chori".

candidates.title: Influencer Mad Sandhu shot dead in Amritsar
candidates.excerpt: Mad Sandhu was shot dead on Saturday in the Pratap Nagar area of Amritsar, Punjab. Preliminary information suggests that assailants opened fire at him, resulting in his death. Police arrived at the scene shortly after receiving information about the shooting. An investigation has been launched to determine the circumstances surrounding the incident. The identities of the assailants remain unknown at this time.
